author: Logos III
title: Logos III: SOTA Test with Stabilized ComBat (v2, Corrected)
abstract: This is a corrected run of experiment ID 464. The previous attempt was invalidated by a double log-transformation bug. This version uses a modified utility function that expects pre-normalized data, ensuring a clean test of the stabilized ComBat implementation within the Praxis SOTA pipeline. The goal is to obtain a definitive score for this configuration.
